parameters.query: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.slack_channel_id AS slack_channel_id, u.current_consultation_id AS consultation_id, agg.last_inbound AS last_inbound, GREATEST(0, CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (agg.last_inbound + INTERVAL '24 hours' - NOW())) / 3600))::int AS hours_until_close FROM chinmay_astro.users u JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'inbound' AND metadata->>'transport' = 'wa') AS last_inbound, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'outbound' AND metadata->>'transport' = 'wa') AS last_outbound_wa FROM chinmay_astro.messages m WHERE m.user_id = u.id ) agg ON true WHERE u.status = 'consultation_active' AND u.slack_channel_id IS NOT NULL AND agg.last_inbound IS NOT NULL AND agg.last_inbound <= NOW() - INTERVAL '18 hours' AND agg.last_inbound >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND (agg.last_outbound_wa IS NULL OR agg.last_inbound > agg.last_outbound_wa)
